title: I Choose You! KRISPY KREME® Launches All-New Pokémon Doughnut Collection Featuring Five Beloved Pokémon
summary: Fans can sweeten celebration of 30 years of Pokémon with special-edition cups showcasing iconic Pokémon Your next Pokémon adventure just got a whole lot sweeter. Krispy Kreme® is teaming up with The Pokémon Company International to celebrate 30 years of Pokémon with a new Pokémon Doughnut Collection, featuring five beloved Pokémon transformed into Krispy Kreme creations fans can catch and share. Fans can sweeten celebration of 30 years of Pokémon with special-edition cups showcasing iconic Pokémon Beginning Tuesday, Aug. 18, for a limited time, Trainers and doughnut lovers can discover Krispy Kreme's new Pokémon Doughnut Collection at participating shops nationwide. Catch five iconic Pokémon-inspired doughnuts with fun flavors or stock up on Poké Ball doughnuts before setting off on your next adventure: Bulbasaur Doughnut – an Original Glazed® doughnut dipped in vanilla flavored icing and topped with frosting and a Bulbasaur piece.
